title: Add id to SceneStreamEnable for RequestError requestId
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[scene] Add id to SceneStreamEnable for RequestError requestId
Spec (81de006): draft-atwood-jmap-scene-wss-00.md L450-452: "**`id`** (String, optional): A client-specified identifier for this message. A `RequestError` caused by this message carries this value as its `requestId` ({{RFC8887}} Section 4.3.4)."
Code: crate-jmap-scene-types/src/stream.rs:33-48; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/ephemeral.rs:108-136; crate-jmap-scene-client/src/ws.rs:87-90
Now: SceneStreamEnable has no typed id; an `id` lands in `extra`. replace_with returns a bare JmapError with nothing for the transport to echo as requestId.
Change: Add `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")] id: Option<String>` to SceneStreamEnable. Document (or return) it so the transport sets requestId on the invalidArguments RequestError.
